content.comment_body: What does the error "Log on fail: 705" mean when I try to connect to the [product_name] web server?

Hello [user_name], If [product_name] displays a Windows-related error, it is a system error: ERROR_FT_WRITE_RECOVERY 705 (0x2C1) {Redundant Write} To fulfill a write request, the NT fault-tolerant file system wrote a redundant copy of the information. This was triggered because the file system encountered a failure on a part of the fault-tolerant volume, but could not reassign the failing part of the device.
In your situation, I recommend submitting a support request.

analysis.insight_summary: A user sees the vague error "Log on fail: 705" when connecting to the [product_name] web server and seeks clarification. Official documentation does not clarify the error, and community advice only links it to a general Windows system error, leaving the original question unresolved. The user’s confusion persists and no specific solution for the [company_name] product is provided.
analysis.user_expectations: User wants clear and relevant error messages tailored to the [company_name] product, as well as useful documentation or guidance to independently address connectivity problems.
